title: Hat Hanger – Smart Storage for 8 Caps
descriptionHtml:
The pile of caps on the hat shelf. We need to talk about it.

Ten caps in a pile means ten flattened brims – and your favorite is always at the bottom.

The solution: one hanger, eight caps

Hang the hanger in the closet and give every cap its own spot. The brims keep their shape, you see the whole collection in a second – and the hat shelf gets to breathe again.

Features

  • Eight caps on one hanger
  • The brims keep their shape – gentle storage
  • The whole collection in a second
  • Fits all standard closets
  • For the hallway, closet and dorm room
